about.seoDescription: STRIVE Physical Therapy supports people rebuilding mobility, confidence, communication, and daily independence.
about.title: STRIVE Physical Therapy
about.subtitle: Neurologic and functional rehabilitation in Las Vegas
about.p1: STRIVE Physical Therapy helps people move, communicate, and participate in daily life with more confidence. Care is centered on practical goals, clear education, and therapy that fits real routines at home and in the community.
about.p2: STRIVE Talk was created as a supportive AAC tool for people who need extra help expressing needs, preferences, medical information, and daily choices while recovering or adapting.
about.goalsText: Personalized rehabilitation, practical communication support, family education, and progress toward meaningful daily activities.
about.featuresText: Adults working through neurologic recovery, speech or communication changes, mobility challenges, balance concerns, and greater independence with everyday tasks.
about.techText: This app is a companion communication tool from STRIVE Physical Therapy, designed to make key phrases and personal information easier to access.
